description:
Goal: finish the first-class callable-boundary cutover in the architecture that now exists. Direct executable calls remain DirectCallTarget::Local. A materialized closure carries producer-owned callable construction members behind one public callable boundary and is invoked indirectly through that value. Native lowering now emits CallClosure/TailCallClosure with direct_target=None; it must not retain a second per-FnId closure-target surface model or reconstruct capture/argument ABI from consumers.

The behavior originally sought by this umbrella is already live through the callable-boundary and fz-k22.23 construction model. Remaining work is deletion-only cleanup in fz-9i4.4.4. Acceptance: the dormant native closure-target registry/direct-target branches are gone; callable boundary wrappers and producer-owned member facts remain authoritative; closure_typed_captures, curried_add, multi_caller_spec_divergent, and the two-distinct-Enum.map regression pass run/interp/build; lib and clippy are green.
title: Complete the callable-boundary cutover by deleting the retired native closure-target model
